title: Antigravity Transport Parity Contract
description: Machine-readable contract defining the TLS transport parity axes between the plugin and the official agy CLI. Each axis has an expected value (measured from agy), a tolerance, and a description. The transport_check.py tool measures the plugin's actual transport and compares against this contract.

ja3.description: TLS ClientHello JA3 fingerprint (MD5 of ordered ciphers, extensions, groups, point formats)

alpn.description: ALPN protocols offered in ClientHello (agy sends none toward daily-cloudcode-pa)

cipher_count.description: Number of cipher suites offered in ClientHello (stdlib reaches 13 via set_ciphers)

cipher_order.description: Ordered cipher suite IDs (Go carries 49200/TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256, which stdlib does not implement)

supported_groups.description: Ordered list of supported groups (key share groups) in ClientHello

extension_order.description: Ordered list of TLS extension types in ClientHello

ec_point_formats.description: EC point formats offered in ClientHello

permissive.description: Log divergence, never block. Always operational.

strict.description: Fail-closed: refuse to send if any axis diverges beyond tolerance.
